name: @pursuit-amsterdam/workflows
description: Reusable GitHub Actions workflows and composite actions. The scripts below are what CI and people run; see docs/v2.

scripts.lint: actionlint && shellcheck -s bash check-pr.sh scripts/*.sh && tsc
scripts.test: scripts/check-pr-cases.sh && scripts/deploy-vercel-cases.sh && scripts/deploy-swarm-cases.sh && scripts/cd-supabase-cases.sh && scripts/release-draft-cases.sh && node --test scripts/lib/
